q: The Pesin entropy formula for a C¹⁺α diffeomorphism preserving a measure μ absolutely continuous w.r.t. Lebesgue states:
opts: h_μ(T) = Σ max(λᵢ, 0) (sum of positive Lyapunov exponents)
exp: Pesin's formula: for SRB measures (absolutely continuous conditionals on unstable manifolds), h_μ(T) = ∫ Σ⁺ λᵢ dμ. Combined with Margulis-Ruelle inequality (h ≤ Σ⁺ λᵢ for any invariant μ), it characterizes SRB measures.
